Internal infrastructure classed conditions diagnostic flags: results flagged, never silently corrected. Physical constants (Kelvin offset, Stefan-Boltzmann constant, solar constant, von Karman constant, gravity, specific heat air, density water FAO-56 latent heat vaporization) defined , unit, source verification status. registry diagnostic flags assembled one table per METRIC stage records, code, stage, severity (now including critical), scope, bit, error counterpart, specification version. Flag records also carry stage scope. New diagnostic flags soil heat flux stage: EF_G_RN_NONPOSITIVE, EF_G_RATIO_NEGATIVE, EF_G_AVAILABLE_NONPOSITIVE EF_G_LOW_LAI_BRANCH. Diagnostic flags radiation stage registered: EF_RAD_SELF_SHADED, EF_RAD_ATM_EMISSIVITY_GT1, EF_RAD_RS_GT_RA EF_RAD_RN_NEGATIVE. computed numeric inputs outputs, never numeric functions, return values unchanged. Classed conditions can carry optional data fields (example diagnostics failed calibration); new condition classes calibration errors convergence warnings.
